title: The Snowman
overview: The Snowman, created and illustrated by Raymond Briggs, is one of the world's most popular and iconic picture books which perfectly captures the wonder and innocence of childhood. This timeless and magical tale tells a story of imagination and friendship as well as love and loss.

In this episode:
It's a beautiful snowy day in Balamory, and Miss Hoolie is planning to visit the Mcleod family, but Josie Jump brings in the news that Christopher has a terrible cold. Josie Jump and Miss Hoolie come up with a novel way of entertaining him.
